species.name: Striped bass
why: Water 71°F on top, right in their comfort range.
Best water today is 4–32 ft deep, mostly on open water over the deep basin.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 40 ft, cold below.
Little oxygen below about 65 ft, so fish stay above it.
